## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Verified:** The change fixes the reported overflow of the menu's empty-state message. No issues were found in the reviewed scope.

| Menu with a filter that matches nothing | Before (PR base) | After (this PR) |
|---|---|---|
| Empty-state text | `No matches for “<query>”` | `No matches found` |
| Text width | Grows with the query | Constant, same length as the existing `Nothing here yet` |
| Long query | Centred text spills past both card edges | Text stays inside the card |
| Where the query is shown | Header (elided) and empty state | Header (elided) |

**Verified mechanism:** The empty-state `Text` in `shell/plugins/menu/Menu.qml` is centred. It keeps Qt's default `NoWrap` and `ElideNone`, and no ancestor clips it. A line wider than its box therefore paints past both sides of the card, and the box itself (`Style.space(320)`) is wider than the default 300 px menu card. A fixed message removes the dependence on query length. The author's before/after screenshots match this reading of the source.

**Optional follow-up (outside this PR):** `shell/plugins/emojis/Emojis.qml` and `shell/plugins/clipboard/Clipboard.qml` still build `No matches for “<query>”` in the same unconstrained, centred `Text`. Their cards are wider (400 px and 875 px at default scale), so a longer query is needed, but the same overflow mechanism applies. The same change there would keep the pickers consistent. This is based on source reading only and was not rendered.

---

## Review information

**Test scope:** Source review of head `a2589d7` against its base, including the menu layout and the Qt Quick `Text` defaults and alignment code (qtdeclarative 6.8.3, 6.9.0 and 6.11.2; qtbase 6.11.2), plus the author's before/after screenshots. No rendered or runtime test was run. The Omarchy, Quickshell and Qt versions the author tested were not stated.

**AI process:** Opus 5.5 Medium coordination and synthesis, independent Opus 5.5 Xhigh and GPT 6 Sol Xhigh technical assessments, Opus 5.5 Medium editorial check.
